Offline (recorded decisions, noise seed fixed): teacher projection 0.28 on 17 check decisions from other failed episodes (matched random control 0.00); on the 11 of those used by neither this nor a 12-decision build it is -0.15. Closed loop on practice: 9/32 -> 0/32; every edited episode fails at object_grabbed(rubiks_cube): the edited GR00T reaches for the banana first and never grabs the cube (videos/RubiksCubeThenBananaTask_30004_*). Likely cause: token alignment only covers the 8 orig positions after the difference, while the explicit wording's inserted clause ('in the bowl then put') has no position in the original prompt; the transferred change at 'the banana in the bowl' arrives without the cube clause. Grasp-phase offline check (16 decisions, k = 4/8/12/16 of slots 30016-30019, none used to build): the teacher changes the executed chunk's end-effector target by 0.88 cm on average, the edit by 1.86 cm, away from the teacher (projection -0.07); pinning every image token to zero (bb_tok) gives 1.84 cm, so the break is not the edit leaking into the visual tokens.
